title: observability-migration-shim-zero-downtime-prometheus-terraform-helm
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private installs hit two recurring operational pain points during upgrades and capacity changes: (1) PrometheusRule/Alertmanager/Grafana dashboard state can be lost or inconsistently applied across tenants during helm upgrades, and (2) migrating from node-agent based collectors to an agentless, central metrics proxy (needed for air-gapped environments) is error-prone. This PR introduces a migration-shim and supporting modules to automate zero-downtime observability upgrades for private installs. Key pieces: 1) terraform/modules/prometheus-remote: new Terraform module that templates and applies a remote_write shim to route tenant metrics to an operator-controlled remote endpoint during migration windows; includes idempotent state transitions and changelog annotations for auditability. 2) helm/observability/metrics-proxy: a new subchart implementing an "agentless metrics proxy" which accepts scraped metrics via authenticated pull from customers' scrape endpoints or via short-lived scrape tokens; supports TLS termination and KMS-backed signing for token rotation. 3) helm/observability/migration-hook: pre-upgrade and post-upgrade helm hooks that snapshot PrometheusRules, AlertmanagerConfigs, and GrafanaFolderSync resources into a CRD-backed store (ObservableConfig) to guarantee preservation across chart schema changes. 4) kube/upgrade-playbooks: an upgrade & rollback playbook and an in-cluster job that validates alerting behavior post-upgrade using a lightweight canary generator and smoke-checker that queries alertmanager / grafana annotations. 5) tests/e2e: github actions workflow + terraform smoke test that runs in a simulated private install on KIND with mocked storage to validate zero-downtime during sequential chart upgrades. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented with example usage - [x] Helm subchart (metrics-proxy) + docs - [x] Migration helm hooks + CRD (ObservableConfig) for safe state preservation - [x] Playbook and in-cluster validation job - [x] e2e smoke tests and CI workflow - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes linked below Backwards compatibility: the migration-shim is opt-in via values and terraform variable toggles; default behavior is no-change. Rollback-safety: states are stored in CRD and annotated with git-like changelog so rollbacks re-apply preserved config. Related: ENG-4019 (dashboard-versioning RFC), previous work on prometheus operator upgrades. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/notes/observability-migration-shim (internal).

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Overall looks good — I'm concerned about token rotation in air-gapped environments, can we add a fallback to long-lived bootstrap tokens?
Aisha Patel (author): Added KMS-backed signing and a fallback bootstrap token flow that requires manual rotation (docs updated).
Rae Chen: The helm hooks look idempotent but we should ensure hooks don't block long upgrades; suggest moving snapshot to async Job — updated.
Omar Haddad: e2e KIND tests are helpful; ran locally and validated alert preservation. Approved with minor doc edits.

merge_commit_message: observability: add migration-shim, prometheus remote terraform module and metrics-proxy helm subchart\n\nZero-downtime observability upgrade tooling for private installs. Includes CRD-backed snapshotting and smoke tests.
release_notes: Add optional observability migration-shim: terraform module for remote-write shim, a new metrics-proxy helm subchart, CRD-backed snapshotting for PrometheusRules/Alertmanager/Grafana resources, and upgrade/rollback playbooks. Opt-in via values/terraform flags. See docs/upgrades/observability-migration.md for migration steps.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in production: 1) enable terraform module with maintenance window tag, 2) pre-warm metrics-proxy in test namespace, 3) run upgrade playbook to snapshot current rules, 4) monitor smoke-check job and alerting for 15 minutes before completing rollout.
post_merge_tasks: Schedule a runbook walkthrough with SREs
small_risk_summary: Opt-in feature guarded by flags. CRD store holds authoritative snapshots so accidental state loss risk is low. Primary risk is misconfigured remote_write leading to duplicated metrics; mitigation: explicit opt-in and dry-run mode in terraform module.
